fields.description: Marèva is Emaar’s four to six bedroom villa collection at The Oasis. The neighbourhood is planned around water, greenery and shared recreation, with contemporary homes designed for family living and entertaining. Its 311-villa launch release is distinct from Marèva 2.

overview: The brochure presents a waterfront community with beaches, landscaped paths and outdoor recreation. Villa interiors use warm neutral colours, while balconies and roof terraces extend the living spaces outside. Facility opening dates and the outlook of an individual plot should be checked separately.
research.locationNote: The Oasis sits in Dubai’s southern villa corridor. The brochure identifies Al Maktoum International Airport, Dubai Hills Mall, Dubai Marina and Downtown Dubai as reference destinations. Journey times depend on the chosen route and traffic.
research.priceNote: Emaar advertises Marèva from AED 13.47m. Its launch sheet lists four-bedroom villas from AED 13.47m, five-bedroom villas from AED 15.38m and six-bedroom villas from AED 23.47m. Property Finder displays a higher current headline around AED 14m while also marking the developer project sold out. Confirm a current unit quotation and availability.
research.paymentNote: The launch plan is 10% on booking, seven further 10% instalments and 20% at estimated completion. Later stages are linked to 40%, 60% and 80% construction. Past calendar dates are historical obligations, not a fresh payment offer; request the schedule applicable to your purchase.
research.handoverNote: The Marèva payment sheet estimates completion in February 2030, consistent with Property Finder. The contractual date and latest construction programme require confirmation.

facts.label: Marèva launch collection
facts.value: 311 standalone villas: 155 four-bedroom, 69 five-bedroom and 87 six-bedroom homes. Launch minimum plots are respectively 8,105, 8,705 and 14,384 sq ft; actual plots vary.
